lines.zh: 海面上我一整天都不用落。
lines.en: I can go all day without landing on the sea.
My wingtips almost touch the water.

lines.zh: 我不怎么拍翅，风就够了。
lines.en: I barely beat my wings. The wind is enough.

lines.zh: 我绕着船转了一个大圈。
lines.en: I make a wide circle around the ship.
I bank left and slide down the air.
The sea moves ceaselessly beneath me.
I ride a current upward.
I settle onto the water and float.
The surface holds me, steady.
Two pushes and I am airborne again.
I sweep past the rocks.

lines.zh: 海雾里只能看见我的翅。
lines.en: In the sea fog only my wings show.

lines.zh: 我一直跟着同一个方向。
lines.en: I keep to the same heading.

lines.zh: 这条航线我飞过很多次。
lines.en: I have flown this course many times.
I need no chart.
The sea tells me itself.
I float with my wings folded.
A swell lifts me, then sets me down.
An island far off. Very small.
I stare at it a long while.
Sea birds cry, sharp and thin.

lines.zh: 海风把我的羽毛翻过来。
lines.en: The sea wind flips my feathers back.

lines.zh: 风从背后吹，我缩起脖子。
lines.en: Wind from behind; I tuck my neck in.
It keeps off some of the wind.
The sea throws back a hard glare.
I close my eyes a while.
A fish breaks the surface.
I did not move at all.
It falls back. The splash is white.

lines.zh: 浪打过来，我睁眼又闭上。
lines.en: A wave slaps by; I open my eyes and close them.
You are on the boat; I circle you.

lines.zh: 我的翅展得很开，比船还宽。
lines.en: My wings are spread wider than the boat.
You are holding fish.
I drop a little lower.
The wind pushes me off my line.
I come back around.
If you do not wave, I will not come down.
I hold above your head half a second.
Then I slide away.
I will return.
A wing skews and I sideslip.
I settle on the water to recover.
A feather on my wing has broken.
I smooth it back.
I fly a little crooked.
I fly low, hugging the swell.
It saves some effort.
The sea keeps holding me.
I steady myself by degrees.
I can still fly a long way.
That is fish. I see it.
I descend from height.
I land on the water by the boat.
I float and wait for you to throw.

lines.zh: 鱼落在我旁边，我一口叼住。
lines.en: It lands beside me and I snap it up.
It tastes a little salty.
I lift my head again.
Is there more fish?
You still have one in your hand.
I float and wait.

lines.zh: 船身晃了一下，我赶紧抬翅。
lines.en: The boat lurches and I lift my wings.
A swell pushes me against the hull.

lines.zh: 我用翅撑了一下，稳住了。
lines.en: I brace with a wing and steady.
My wingtip takes water and grows heavy.
I shake my wings twice.
I can fly again.
You reach out; I slide back.

lines.zh: 翅尖擦过浪，划出一道白。
lines.en: My wingtip grazes the swell and leaves white water.
I move to the far side of the swell.
That distance is right.
Another circles far off.
I circle too.
Our wingtips nearly touch.
We glide side by side a long while.
There is an open patch on the island.
We come down there.
The wind is strong; we keep close.
The season is right.
We will stay here a while.
Then fly out again.
I settle on the water and take it in my beak.
A piece of wood. Not fish.

lines.zh: 叼了一下，不是鱼，我丢开。
lines.en: One hold, not a fish, I let it drop.
It floats beside me.
I nudge it and it turns once.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的鱼，飞过整片海。
lines.en: I follow your fish across the whole sea.
This one floats well.
This driftwood has no smell of fish.
Then I take off again.
It stays where it was.
A flash of silver; a school of fish.
I watch from above.
A shoal, close to the surface.
I draw my wings in.
Then drop straight down.

lines.zh: 我贴着浪尖飞了一整天。
lines.en: I've flown the wave tops all day.
I surface with something in my beak.
Not large, but enough.
I tip my head back and swallow.
The surface flattens again.
I drop low, hugging the water.
That patch of water is moving.
I carve a circle.
The shoal scatters.
I wait for them to gather.
The wind lifts me.
I bank and press down.
The surface comes closer.
Over the sea, my shadow arrives first.
The fish sink. Too late.
My beak closes on the fish's back.
It flaps in my beak.
I tip my head and send it down.
My throat works once.
Water runs off my beak.
I lie on the sea without moving.
My wings spread on the water.
The sun is warm.
A while later I move.
I kick and beat my wings twice.
I come out of the sea fog.
Water beads on my wings.
Nothing below but swell.
I climb a little.
There is a boat far off.
I head that way.
I need not land on it.
Circling is enough.
Wind from the left; I bank into it.
My shadow falls on the waves.

lines.zh: 火燎过我的翅尖，我立刻压低。
lines.en: Fire scorches my wingtip and I drop at once.

lines.zh: 我被风甩下去，砸在水面上。
lines.en: The wind throws me down onto the water.

lines.zh: 浪把我按下去，我拼命往上挣。
lines.en: A swell presses me under; I fight upward.

lines.zh: 爆炸的气浪把我推得翻了半圈。
lines.en: The blast throws me half a turn.

lines.zh: 一支箭钻透了我的翼膜。
lines.en: An arrow pierces my wing's membrane.

lines.zh: 怪光罩住我，翅拍不动了。
lines.en: Strange light wraps me and my wings will not beat.

lines.zh: 好几天没鱼，我飞得越来越低。
lines.en: Days without fish; I fly lower and lower.

lines.zh: 雷落在海上，我全身一麻。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the sea and I go numb.

lines.zh: 海不见了，我在黑里一直坠。
lines.en: The sea is gone and I fall through black.
